test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The 1991 reforms led to major tax policy changes to boost efficiency and compliance. Which tax reform, implemented in 2017, aimed to unify India's indirect tax structure?
solution:
The correct answer is __**GST**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Goods and Services Tax (GST)** was implemented on **1 July 2017** to replace multiple indirect taxes in India.
 
• It is a **comprehensive, multi-stage, and destination-based tax** that is levied on every value addition, making the tax system more transparent and efficient.
 
• GST unified India's indirect tax structure by subsuming taxes such as VAT, excise duty, service
